newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: Slovak cbank sets one-week repo, min rate 8.8 pct.
newsitem.headline: Slovak cbank sets one-week repo, min rate 8.8 pct.

text.p: The National Bank of Slovakia (NBS) on Tuesday set a one-week repo tender to add market liquidity up to a maximum of 2.0 billion crowns.
The minimum rate in the American-style tender was set at 8.8 percent, equal to the discount rate, a central bank statement said.
The NBS added 4.0 billion crowns to the interbank market through a one-week repo tender on Monday, with the average rate rising to 17.43 percent from 16.50 percent in a similar repo on Friday.
The central bank monitors market liquidity on a daily basis and decides each morning whether to hold any open market operations.

According to NBS figures, the Slovak banking sector as of July 28 lacked 0.77 percent of funds needed to meet minimum reserves requirements. The daily volume of minimum reserves for commercial banks total 36.583 billion crowns in the current reserves period ending July 31.
